title: Who Shall Dwell on Your Holy Hill?

questions.question: O Lord, who shall sojourn in your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 15:1 (ESV): "O Lord, who shall sojourn in your tent? Who shall dwell on your holy hill?"

questions.question: He who walks blamelessly and does what is what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 15:2 (ESV): "He who walks blamelessly and does what is right..."

questions.question: And speaks truth in his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 15:2 (ESV): "...and speaks truth in his heart;"

questions.question: Who does not slander with his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 15:3 (ESV): "who does not slander with his tongue..."

questions.question: He who does these things shall never be what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 15:5 (ESV): "He who does these things shall never be moved."

questions.question: In whose eyes a vile person is despised, but who honors those who fear whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 15:4 (ESV): "in whose eyes a vile person is despised, but who honors those who fear the Lord;"

questions.question: Who swears to his own hurt and does not do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 15:4 (ESV): "who swears to his own hurt and does not change;"

questions.question: Who does not put out his money at what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 15:5 (ESV): "who does not put out his money at interest..."

questions.question: And does not take a bribe against the whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 15:5 (ESV): "...and does not take a bribe against the innocent."

questions.question: He does no evil to his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 15:3 (ESV): "...and does no evil to his neighbor,"

questions.question: Nor takes up a reproach against his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 15:3 (ESV): "...nor takes up a reproach against his friend;" (ESV note: or neighbor).

questions.question: Who shall dwell on your holy what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 15:1 (ESV): "Who shall dwell on your holy hill?"

questions.question: How many characteristics of the righteous person are listed (approximately)?
questions.explanation: Depending on how you count, roughly 10-11 traits are listed in verses 2-5.

questions.question: What is the genre of Psalm 15?
questions.explanation: It describes the requirements for entering God's presence/tent.

key_verse_text: O Lord, who shall sojourn in your tent? Who shall dwell on your holy hill? He who walks blamelessly and does what is right and speaks truth in his heart;
